channel.title: Parallel Computing on Mmirko
channel.description: Recent content in Parallel Computing on Mmirko

item.title: BondMachine article about ML on FPGAs published
item.description: After some months of work, I am pleased to announce that our article about using BondMachine to generate FPGA accelerators for machine learning applications has been published on the MDPI journal Electronics.

item.title: Talk at CCR Workshop 2025 at Biodola
item.description: I presented our latest work about quantum computing simulation on FPGA at the Workshop of the CCR of INFN.

item.title: Talk at SOSC 2024
item.description: I gave a talk about FPGA-based reconfigurable computing at the SOSC 2024 Sixth International School on Open Science Cloud held in Bologna, Italy, on December 2, 2024.

item.title: Introductory course to HLS FPGA programming
item.description: I have been invited as Lecturer at the Introductory course to HLS FPGA programming, a course thought for the new personnel hired by means of the ICSC project to work on projects and research activities in the framework of Spoke 2 (“Fundamental Research And Space Economy”).

item.title: Talk at SOSC 2023
item.description: I gave a talk about FPGA-based reconfigurable computing at the SOSC 2023 Fifth International School on Open Science Cloud held in Perugia, Italy, on October 23, 2023.

item.title: BondMachine Project Thrives with Four Talks in Late 2022
item.description: The year 2022 drew to a close with an exhilarating period for the BondMachine project, as it witnessed the presentation of four captivating talks across various locations.

item.title: Talk at CCR Workshop 2022 in Paestum
item.description: I presented our latest work about creating computing accelerators at Workshop of the CCR of INFN.

item.title: 18th advanced school on parallel computing
item.description: During all the week, I partecipated to the 18th advanced school on parallel computing by cineca.

item.title: Article on the BondMachine published
item.description: After a lot of work and some trouble, finally our article on the BondMachine has been published on Parallel Computing (Elsevier) a peer-reviewed journal.

item.title: Talk at ParCo 2019
item.description: I travelled to Prague and I gave a talk at ParCo Conference 2019.
